auth.label: API Key
auth.description: WhatsAble API key sent with the Authorization header. Copy it from API Keys in the WhatsAble dashboard: https://dashboard.whatsable.app.

actions.name: send_message
actions.description: Send one WhatsApp text message with an optional attachment URL through WhatsAble.

to.description: The recipient phone number in E.164 format, including the leading plus sign.

text.description: The text content of the WhatsApp message.

attachment.description: A public HTTP or HTTPS URL that WhatsAble can fetch as an attachment.

filename.description: The filename shown for a document attachment.

inputSchema.description: The recipient, message text, and optional public attachment sent through WhatsAble.

success.description: Whether WhatsAble accepted the message request.

message.description: A human-readable summary of the submission result.

message_status.description: The acceptance status of the WhatsApp message.

items.description: A WhatsApp message accepted by WhatsAble.

messages.description: WhatsApp messages accepted by the upstream service.

details.description: Additional message delivery details returned by WhatsAble.

outputSchema.description: The WhatsAble acceptance response for the submitted message.
